title: Temple of the Holy Spirit
definition: Temple of the Holy Spirit describes believers as those in whom the Holy Spirit dwells, making their bodies and the Church holy unto God.
summary: Believers belong to God because the Holy Spirit dwells in them.
christFocus: Jesus purchased His people, and the Spirit makes them God's dwelling place.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The temple of the Holy Spirit teaches that God's presence now dwells in His people by the Spirit. This applies to individual believers and to the Church as God's dwelling.

Because believers are temples of the Spirit, their bodies matter. They are not their own; they were bought with a price.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people treat the body as either worthless or self-owned. This doctrine matters because the body belongs to God and is indwelt by His Spirit.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Honor God with your body, speech, habits, sexuality, and service. Remember that you belong to Christ and are indwelt by the Spirit.
